full_judgment:
Mr. A.B.M. Khairul Haque, J: This Rule Nisi was issued under Article 102 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh at the instance of Dr. Md. Alamgir, calling upon the Vice Chancellor, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET) and another to show cause as to why they should not be directed for finalisation of selection and appointment of the petitioner to the post of Assistant Professor, in the Department of Civil Engineering, BUET, as recommended by the Selection Board, in pursuance to the advertisement published on 19.4.2001 issued by the Respondent No. 2 and as to why Ad-hoc appointment made by the Respondent. Nos. 1 and 2 to the posts of Assistant Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, BUET in favour of Respondent Nos. 3 and 4, issued under the Signature of Respondent No. 2 (Annexure-F and G) should not be declared to have been made without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. On he prayer of the petitioner, there was an order of stay for regularization of appointments of the Respondent Nos. 3 and 4. 

 13. After due advertisement, candidates are selected by the Selection Board of the University. The Selection Board also consists of highly educated and responsible persons. It, appears in this case that after due selection the Syndicate failed to take any decision in respect of the appointments in the two posts of Assistant Professors., rather sat on it for months together, apparently without any reason, although similar decisions are being taken in respect of other Departments.
